description:
## Objective

Add executable durability, pattern, and distribution examples for Action and Exec.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-03-1512-consolidated-quality-backpressure-plan.md`
Unit: `U11`
Covers: `R1, R2, R4, R6; KTD1, KTD2, KTD4, KTD6, KTD8.`

Implement only this quality-import unit. Follow the plan decisions. Do not change `lib/**` or `../refs/**`. When a source assertion needs a product change, record the asset as deferred with the failing command.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: jido-07x.6 (U6) — Port Action system and load checks must be complete; jido-07x.8 (U8) — Add the example catalog harness must be complete.
- Unblocks: jido-07x.20 (U20) — Enforce quality gates in CI and agent guidance must be complete.

## Files

Read Action example groups `03_durability/**`, `04_patterns/**`, and `05_distribution/**` with their tests at commit `40ec1f0af3a373bae5e6d869017cc229c85aef92`. Add `examples/flow/advanced/**` and matching tests. Change the manifest.

## Instructions

1. Port each example that passes against current public behavior.
2. Keep process recovery, cancellation, compaction, worker claim, fencing, compensation, and distribution assertions.
3. Defer a source example instead of changing `lib/**` when behavior is missing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every source example in the three groups has a manifest disposition.
- [ ] Ported examples use barriers or monitors for ordering.
- [ ] Deferred examples record the exact failing command and expected behavior.

## Verification

- `mix test.examples test/examples/flow/advanced` exits with status `0`.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source manifest records, verification results, deferred assets, deviations from the plan, and remaining blockers.

comments.text: Completed in e3a37dc. Added 9 numbered supported lessons: 6 durability and 3 patterns. Added 14 executable skipped probes for delivery rules, DETS recovery, compaction, production Store, automatic recovery, audit trace, worker claim, fenced result, durable static ReAct audit, and all 5 cluster distribution contracts. Every source lesson has a manifest disposition. Ported ordering uses message barriers, process monitors, wait addressing, or managed hooks. Deviations: current public Jido.Exec and Runic.Runner APIs replace the removed Run, Store, Dispatcher, and wave APIs. Verification: focused supported examples 10 passed; catalog 8 passed; full examples 45 passed; manifest 6 passed; default deferred run excluded 14; explicit deferred run failed 14 of 14 as recorded; compile warnings, format, and diff checks passed. No lib or reference files changed.

title: Port advanced Action examples
